capabilities: Chat with the active document in a sidebar with streaming responses and persistent history
Edit selected text inline by describing the change in a floating input (append or replace)
Run built-in actions such as summarize, continue writing, fix grammar, and generate code
Send selected text to the chat sidebar as context via right-click
Create and edit custom actions with own prompts and choose models in settings
extras: Requires Obsidian Desktop v1.0.0+, a globally installed GitHub Copilot CLI (v0.0.409+), an active Copilot subscription, and CLI authentication; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance, so users cannot use a GitHub Copilot subscription to chat with or rewrite their notes from inside the vault.

relations.evidence: integrates GitHub Copilot with Obsidian, allowing you to chat with your documents
This plugin uses the official @github/copilot-sdk for TypeScript/Node.js

summary: Plugin that connects the GitHub Copilot CLI to Obsidian for sidebar chat with documents, inline edits, and prompt-based text actions.
